item.title: The Analysts Are Compromised & "Why" It's <Fine>
item.description:
Wall Street's analysts love SpaceX & Tesla; here's "why" <that> matters.
https://x.com/edels0n/status/2077031491045929255?s=46&t=tracking

Why would analysts cheer? Here's the hook.

That's from The Analysts Are Compromised, by Ed Elson.

Déjà Vu

According to JPMorgan, SpaceX is worth 2.9 trillion dollars. Rated 4## stars.
As the report puts it, incentives matter ]]> a lot.
> Nested quote line

Here To Stay 🚀

The solution is simple: fix the incentives. Don’t hold your breath.

That was The Analysts Are Compromised, by Ed Elson.

item.title: A long read without an author or an excerpt
item.description:
This narration has no stored excerpt, so the feed truncates the content itself to two hundred and fifty five characters, including the three dots of the suffix. It keeps going well past that limit so the truncation is visible in the golden output, and ...
https://example.com/long-read?p=1&ref=rss

This narration has no stored excerpt, so the feed truncates the content itself to two hundred and fifty five characters, including the three dots of the suffix. It keeps going well past that limit so the truncation is visible in the golden output, and mentions <angle brackets> & ampersands too.
